identificationModule.briefTitle: A Study of Carboplatin-Paclitaxel/Nab-Paclitaxel Chemotherapy With or Without Pembrolizumab (MK-3475) in Adults With First Line Metastatic Squamous Non-small Cell Lung Cancer (MK-3475-407/KEYNOTE-407)
identificationModule.officialTitle: A Randomized, Double-Blind, Phase III Study of Carboplatin-Paclitaxel/Nab-Paclitaxel Chemotherapy With or Without Pembrolizumab (MK-3475) in First Line Metastatic Squamous Non-small Cell Lung Cancer Subjects (KEYNOTE-407)

armGroups.label: Pembrolizumab + Chemotherapy Combo
armGroups.description: Participants receive pembrolizumab 200 mg by intravenous (IV) infusion prior to chemotherapy on Day 1 of each 21-day cycle (Q3W) for up to 35 cycles (\~ 2 years) PLUS Investigator's choice of paclitaxel (200 mg/m\^2 by IV infusion on Day 1 of each 21-day cycle for 4 cycles) or nab-paclitaxel (100 mg/m\^2 by IV infusion on Days 1, 8, 15 of each 21-day cycle for 4 cycles) PLUS carboplatin area under the curve (AUC) 6 by IV infusion on Day 1 of each 21-day cycle for 4 cycles.

armGroups.label: Placebo + Chemotherapy
armGroups.description: Participants receive normal saline as placebo by IV infusion prior to chemotherapy on Day 1 of each 21-day cycle for up to 35 cycles (\~ 2 years) PLUS Investigator's choice of paclitaxel (200 mg/m\^2 by IV infusion on Day 1 of each 21-day cycle for 4 cycles) or nab-paclitaxel (100 mg/m\^2 by IV infusion on Days 1, 8, 15 of each 21-day cycle for 4 cycles) PLUS carboplatin AUC 6 by IV infusion on Day 1 of each 21-day cycle for 4 cycles.

interventions.name: Carboplatin
interventions.description: IV infusion Carboplatin dose should not to exceed 900 mg.
